Share of the Midway fee paid to the referrer, in basis points. Zero at launch.
Share of purchaser rewards skimmed into the Shared Upside pot, in basis points.
Unix timestamp when the first Shared Upside cycle begins.
Length of each Shared Upside cycle, in seconds.
Minimum FWA payout, in wei, below which managed settlement falls back to ETH.
Minimum FWA per ETH conversion rate the floor enforces, scaled by 1e18, or zero to disable the floor.
Maximum slippage the conversion floor tolerates against its TWAP reference, in basis points.
Number of blocks the conversion floor's TWAP observation window spans.
Minimum number of price observations required before the conversion floor is valid.
Chainlink VRF gas lane key hash used for randomness requests.
Chainlink VRF subscription ID that funds randomness requests.
Number of block confirmations Chainlink VRF waits before fulfilling a request.
Gas limit supplied to the VRF fulfillment callback.
Whether VRF requests are paid in native ETH rather than LINK.
Minimum native ETH balance, in wei, the VRF subscription must hold before the keeper tops it up.
